fusions.name: Long Fang
fusions.desc: Thrusts the blade's tip out for 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Sounding Strike
fusions.desc: Rings the blade against the ground. The echo deals 26 resonating damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring armour, and leaves each one [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Undermine
fusions.desc: You drop into the ground and come up at a spot up to 6 tiles away. You gain +8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Gravedigger's Hours
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage.
